notes.title: Castle TriCon Spring 2021 and Free Weekend on Steam!
notes.content:
Join us this weekend!
Dear Leaders and Truckers! Do you have any plans for the weekend? No? Great! We've got two exciting FREE events for you:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32281238/c7464a5994c8fb3b889e3e7458e03bde7701b68e.png

Castle TriCon 2021 Spring Edition
We miss you! And we miss sharing our games with you. So we came up with a solution - Castle TriCon 2021 Spring Edition - a virtual gaming convention in our unique 3D world where you can run around, explore, play demos of our board games, chat with your friends, or make new ones. Completely FOR FREE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32281238/e2f6fca418de124ef20f1afaa1e6fdbc03450a44.gif

We are also hosting a few contests, scavenger hunts, and giveaways so you can win some fantastic prizes as well (you guessed it, it’s mostly board games...but we know you love board games). 

You just need to get your free ticket and download our virtual world, and you are all set! We can't wait to see you there!

Free Weekend for CGE Digital Games
On top of that, we are also hosting a Free Weekend event here on Steam.

What is it, you ask? From February 25th, 10AM PT until March 1st, 10AM PT, you can install and play our digital games Through the Ages and Galaxy Trucker for free as well!

So if you wanted to buy them but were not sure if you would like them -- or tried to persuade your friends to try -- then now is a perfect time. You can challenge yourself and play against our AI opponents, play local games with your family and friends, or start your career as a Galaxy Trucker in our solo campaign mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32281238/ea83f7cbd1154d3128c6e12b8c2209912a162cc3.png

And if you like the games, you can buy them at a discounted price this weekend! Oh, and be sure to visit our TriCon friends from Horrible Guild, they are running a free weekend and some juicy sales as well.

Yours,
CGE Team

notes.title: Replay, Spectate and Graphs!
notes.content:
Good news, everyone!

Today we are releasing three new features for Through the Ages - Replay, Spectate, and Graphs!

With Spectate and Replay mode, you can rewatch any moment from your favorite games, games of your friends (if they share their special code with you), or spectate exciting tournaments. AND at the end of each game, you can review everything in a form of adjustable Graphs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32281238/da206711e1beb3cfb3d21ee81892bbbdaa0749d8.gif

More changes:
- Graphics renderer options (Windows only)
- Fixed occasional incorrect behavior of International Agreement in combination with Fleming or Coubertin
- Fixed challenge syncing issues
- Other minor improvements and optimizations

notes.title: New update including community translations and more
notes.content:
Community translations are here! Huge thanks to everyone who helped us with all the new localizations! Whoever is missing their language in the game is always free to join the community effort – just drop us a message here: community.localizations@czechgames.com 

Full list of what's new in the update:
- We have launched the first community translations (French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese) with more languages to come later (you can join the effort, too)
- An official Korean localization has also been added
- Income management becomes easier – you can now easily see where all your food, resources, science, culture, happy faces, and strength come from
- Lobby and game chat have been improved

Enjoy the game!
CGE Digital team
